venue.shyInToSeeBody: Shyne to appear and see people at this place.
venue.justYouBody: You're Shyning. When someone else does too, they'll show here.
venue.demoPerson: This is a demo person. Shyne yourself to send a real ShyText.
venue.flickA11y: Slide to Shyne at {{name}}. Drag the flame right.

venue.theySentFirst: They already sent you a ShyText

chats.emptyBody: When someone at your venue sends you a ShyText, it shows up here.
chats.closedBody: This chat stays here, but new messages are closed. Go say hi in person.
chats.deleteChatBody: It disappears from your list. If they message you again, it comes back.
chats.rowOptionsHint: Long press to pin or delete
chats.accountDeletedBody: This account is gone. You can still read the chat.

profile.discardBody: Your photo, name, and bio will not be saved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lockScreenFooter: Lock-screen banners never include the note itself.
settings.newShyTextSub: Someone sent you a note at this venue
settings.newChatSub: When someone texts you and you’re not in that chat
settings.checkInEndingSub: About 5 minutes before you go quiet
settings.coShyneSub: When another person lights up at your venue
settings.deleteBody: This permanently removes your photo, name, bio, and profile. Any active Shyne ends immediately. Chats you already started stay with the other person, but your profile will no longer appear.
settings.deleteBody2: You will need to sign in with your phone number again to create a new account.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: We’ll text a code to your phone. Enter it to confirm. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteOtpHint: For security, we’ll send a one-time code to the phone number on your account.

privacy.p1: Your exact location is never shown to other users.
privacy.p2: Location is only used in the foreground to suggest a venue, and to Shy Out if you reopen the app more than 100 meters away.
privacy.p3: Being at a venue never makes you visible. You Shyne on purpose.
privacy.p4: Only people who Shyne at the same venue appear — and only after you Shyne too.
privacy.p5: We never show how many silent people are nearby.
privacy.p6: Chats stay private after you Shy Out or your Shyne expires. After an hour, the thread stays but new messages close so you can talk in person.
privacy.p7: Lock-screen notifications do not include private message text.

push.openToRead: Open the app to read it.
push.endingBody: Open ShyText in the next 5 minutes to stay visible.
push.coShyneBody: You’re both lit at {{venue}} — still time to say hi.

flirt: Can I buy you a drink?

walkthrough.body0: Being at a place shows nothing. Nobody sees you until you choose to Shyne.
walkthrough.bodyPeople: Only people Shyning at your venue appear — and they can see you too.
walkthrough.bodyAccept: If they accept, a private chat opens. If not, it quietly expires.
walkthrough.body1: Slide the flame at your venue. People there can see you while you stay active.
walkthrough.body2: Pick one person and send a short hello. They accept — or it quietly disappears.
walkthrough.body3: A few messages, then go talk. The rest happens offline.
